features.name: v1_v2_sum
features.description: Sum of V1 and V2 coordinates, providing a diagonal linear projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth linear combination of spatial coordinates, directly usable by linear SVM margins.

features.name: v1_v2_diff
features.description: Difference between V1 and V2 coordinates, representing the orthogonal diagonal projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative offset between the two spatial dimensions, useful for linear separation.

features.name: v1_v2_euclidean_center
features.description: Euclidean distance from the approximate center of the coordinate space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Introduces a non-linear radial feature that a linear SVM can use to separate central from peripheral instances.

features.name: v1_v2_manhattan_center
features.description: Manhattan distance from the approximate center of the coordinate space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an alternative L1 distance metric from the center, creating diamond-shaped decision boundaries when used by a linear model.

features.name: v3_log
features.description: Log-transformed V3 intensity to compress the upper tail and smooth the distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme V3 values, creating a smoother continuous feature for the SVM margin.

features.name: v3_squared
features.description: Squared V3 intensity to emphasize higher values and create a non-linear severity measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear SVM to fit a quadratic response to the V3 intensity, increasing sensitivity to high-intensity regions.

features.name: v1_norm
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the scale of V1, ensuring it contributes equally to the SVM margin penalty.

features.name: v2_norm
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the scale of V2, ensuring it contributes equally to the SVM margin penalty.

features.name: v3_norm
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the scale of V3, preventing it from being overshadowed by the larger coordinate values in the SVM optimization.

features.name: v1_v2_max_min_ratio
features.description: Ratio of the maximum to the minimum of V1 and V2, capturing coordinate imbalance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights instances that are far off the diagonal, providing a scale-invariant measure of spatial asymmetry.

features.name: v3_anomaly_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of V3's deviation from typical background levels, scored continuously.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a domain-informed continuous severity score that the linear SVM can weight directly.

features.name: spatial_edge_proximity
features.description: Semantic evaluation of how close the V1, V2 coordinates are to the boundary of the observable region.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures edge effects or boundary conditions that might systematically alter the expected intensity, useful as a linear adjustment factor.
